    input = sys.stdin.read().strip()
    n, m = map(int, input.split())

    if m == 0:
        print(" ".join(map(str, range(10, 10 + n))))
        return

    if n < 3 or m > (n * (n - 1) // 2 - (n - 2)):
        print(-1)
        return

    scores = [0] * n
    scores[0], scores[1] = 1, 2
    balance = 0
    index = 2

    while balance < m and index < n:
        next_score = scores[index - 1] + 1
        while any(next_score == scores[i] + scores[j] for i in range(index - 1) for j in range(i + 1, index)):
            next_score += 1
        scores[index] = next_score
        balance += sum(1 for i in range(index - 1) for j in range(i +1, index) if scores[i] + scores[j] == scores[index])
        index += 1

    if balance != m:
        print(-1)
    else:
        while index < n:
            scores[index] = scores[index - 1] + 1
            index += 1
        print(" ".join(map(str, scores)))
